name: normalization.hom_ext
statement: f.normalization ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom g] (H₁ : f.toNormalization ≫ f₁ = f.toNormalization ≫ f₂) (hf₁ : f₁ ≫ g = f.fromNormalization) (hf₂ : f₂ ≫ g = f.fromNormalization) : f₁ = f₂

have_tree.body: have : IsAffineHom (f₁ ≫ g) := hf₁ ▸ inferInstance; .of_comp _ g
have : IsAffineHom (f₂ ≫ g) := hf₂ ▸ inferInstance; .of_comp _ g

children.name: h₁'
children.type: f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 = toNormalization f ⁻¹ᵁ f₂ ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1

children.name: h₂
children.type: fromNormalization f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 = f₁ ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1

children.name: h₂'
children.type: fromNormalization f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 = f₂ ⁻¹ᵁ g ⁻¹ᵁ U.1

children.name: h₃
children.type: f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 = toNormalization f ⁻¹ᵁ fromNormalization f ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
